title: The mandatory security stated-negative could not be produced, and was not faked
note: The health-review skill is explicit that a clean breach check must be a STATED VERIFICATION and that an empty security finding is a review failure. MEASURED 2026-09-22: 0 of the 5 declared sweep sources were swept. Host auth signals are blocked behind /api/diag/* (3 of 3 probes -> HTTP 401 missing_token, the vm-diag-snapshot relay being down per E19). The four GitHub-side sources (secret scanning, external-actor activity, repo/supply-chain mutations, Actions anomalies) were not run inside this lane's $40 ceiling. [!] THIS ROW EXISTS BECAUSE THE ALTERNATIVE WAS TO WRITE `no breach detected`, WHICH WOULD HAVE BEEN THE FABRICATED REASSURING VALUE the collapsed-states rule forbids. The review reports security as `could_not_look`, not `ok`. [!] PROPOSED FIX (Tier-1): the four GitHub-side sources need no VM access and no DIAG token -- only the MCP session. They should be their own cheap standing lane rather than riding a review that can be budget-truncated, since truncation currently takes the security sweep with it every time. [!] SWEPT 2026-09-22 BY THIS LANE. Record: docs/security/breach-sweep-2026-09-22.md (every claim carries its population, its window and its locator). 0 of 5 -> **2 of 5 swept clean, 1 partial, 2 could_not_look with NAMED, BUILDABLE reasons**. Verdict `watch`, not `ok` and not `concern`: nothing found in anything swept is a breach signal, and `ok` would be dishonest while two sources are unswept. [!] SWEPT CLEAN: (2) EXTERNAL ACTORS -- population is ALL non-owner issues+PRs, all time, total_count 14 = github-actions[bot] 11 + danleejames23 3; collaborators exactly 1 (benbaichmankass, admin). The danleejames23 items are #2680/#2681/#2688, ALL 2026-06-03, ALL closed, and MEASURED TODAY `labels: []` on all three -- the issue relays fire on a LABEL, so the attempt never dispatched anything. Reconciled against docs/security/intrusion-surface-audit-2026-06-28.md and .github/workflows/external-issue-alert.yml, which cites those three issue numbers; NOT novel. Zero external events in the 3 months 19 days since. (4) ACTIONS ANOMALIES -- 500 runs, triggering actors benbaichmankass 491 + github-actions[bot] 9, no third actor, event mix maps to sessions+crons. (3) SUPPLY-CHAIN, partial: force-push to refs/heads/main 0, branch_deletion on main 0, forks 0, tags 0, unattributable actors 0; and over a REAL 30-day window from a clone deepened to 2384 commits, 127 commits touching .github/workflows/ authored ONLY by the owner (103) and github-actions[bot] (24), zero third-party -- repo-wide 2009 commits, 3 authors, all attributable. [!] ⚠️ WINDOWS ARE SHORT WHERE THE API IS PAGE-CAPPED AND ARE STATED AS SUCH, NOT SMOOTHED: activity 13.5h, workflow runs 10.4h. And a trap worth keeping: `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/activity` IGNORES `?page=N` -- five sequential pages returned THE SAME 100 RECORDS and the rel=next cursor did not advance, so a naive sweep would report '500 records, no force-push to main' over 100 records and half a day. Deduping by record id is what made it visible. [!] GAP A -- THE REASON WAS THE FINDING, AND IT IS NOT A CREDENTIAL. secret-scanning/alerts, dependabot/alerts, keys, actions/secrets and hooks ALL return HTTP 403 with the body `Access to this GitHub API path is not permitted through this proxy` -- that is the AGENT PROXY's path allowlist, NOT a repo permission. Proven, not assumed: `collaborators` 403s over raw HTTPS while mcp__github__list_repository_collaborators RETURNS IT on the same credential (two transports, two allowlists, one token), and six control paths (activity/events/branches/ tags/forks/root) all return 200. ⚠️ DO NOT READ THOSE 403s AS 'we lack admin rights' and do NOT ask the operator to mint a token. THE REMEDY IS A FETCHER: a GitHub Actions job runs with no such proxy and can read secret-scanning + dependabot alerts from GITHUB_TOKEN under a `permissions: security-events: read` block. That IS this row's own proposed standing lane, now specified rather than aspirational. STILL TO BUILD. [!] GAP B -- THIS ROW'S OWN DIAGNOSIS OF THE HOST HALF IS SUPERSEDED, BOTH HALVES. The row said '401 missing_token, the vm-diag-snapshot relay being down per E19'. The relay is fixed and OBSERVED (E19, issue #12708, run 35695727461) and DIAG_READ_TOKEN is in this session's env -- and the source is STILL unreachable, structurally. MEASURED direct over ict-bot.duckdns.org with a valid bearer: unit=ssh / ssh.service / sshd / sshd.service ALL return HTTP 400 `unknown_unit`, while the control unit=ict-web-api.service returns HTTP 200 WITH CONTENT. Confirmed in source: src/web/api/routers/diag.py::_CANONICAL_UNITS holds only this project's own systemd units and has no ssh entry. THERE IS NO SPELLING THAT WORKS. So the /health-review skill's MANDATORY 'journalctl for sshd/auth' source has NEVER been satisfiable through the surface it names, on any day -- a binding skill requiring an unobtainable read, the SAME DEFECT CLASS AS E23, found independently. Two remedies, both out of Tier-1 and neither taken: (a) add ssh.service to _CANONICAL_UNITS -- TIER 2, src/web/api/routers/diag.py, guarded by scripts/check_diag_unit_allowlist.py, needs a deploy, and ⚠️ sshd lines carry source IPs and usernames so widening the read is the operator's call; (b) a system-action that runs a fixed-form auth summariser on the host and returns COUNTS (failed->succeeded pairs, new users, new units/timers/ports) rather than raw lines -- narrower, relays no raw auth records. OPERATOR DECISION OWED: which of (a) or (b). No breach attention is owed. [!] WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS ROW `done`: Gap A's runner lane returning a secret-scanning + dependabot + deploy-key + secrets-inventory result, AND one Gap B remedy landing and being OBSERVED returning host auth content. Neither is this PR. [!] MANAGER 2026-09-22: MERGED as 2ab1f284. `done` covers THE SWEEP ONLY -- verdict `watch`, 2 of 5 sources clean, 1 partial, 2 `could_not_look`. The two gaps are NOT closed by this row and do not evaporate with it: they are now E26 (Gap A -- the proxy blocks GitHub's security-alert paths; the remedy is an Actions fetcher, not an operator minting a token) and E27 (Gap B -- _CANONICAL_UNITS has no ssh entry, so the health-review's MANDATORY sshd source has never been satisfiable; Tier-2 or an operator decision).
